line: English KJV Bible story, one story per long video, cinematic and narrated (the channel's series, SERIES.md)

missing: a separating driver: none of 11 structure attributes separates winners from weak (the weak share the winners' structure); next test is the package (title, thumbnail) and the story chosen
more weak contrasts (3 is the minimum; one attribute, burned captions, reads anti on 2/3)
validation.reading: the structure is consistent (hygiene measured 7/7 and 3/3) but not what makes a long win; it stays candidate and is piloted with the hygiene targets below

one_story_per_video.label: free (winners 7/7, weak 1/3)
one_story_per_video.values: every winner tells one complete story; one weak is a 'Part 1', one sprawls several stories
one_story_per_video.target: one complete arc per long, never 'Part N' (SERIES.md)

length_min.label: shape
length_min.note: 14-47 min winners, 11-50 min weak: length does not separate

title.values: story name first + human angle + 'Genesis N Bible Story'
title.label: candidate driver

cold_open_conflict.label: hygiene
cold_open_conflict.target: the conflict (judgment, giant, jealousy) shown and named in the first 30 s; by a character in 2/7 winners (Goliath, the Sodom scoffer)

rehooks.label: hygiene
rehooks.target: a re-hook at every chapter end (a question or a cliffhanger line)

reflection_s.label: free
reflection_s.target: <= 125 s (the weak Sodom spent 6 min on an epilogue)

burned_captions.label: anti (winners 1/7, weak 2/3; 3 weak only)
burned_captions.target: no burned captions on the long; YouTube captions instead (re-check with more weak contrasts)

slow_stretches.label: retention risk in 10/10
slow_stretches.target: no landscape, montage, process or repeated shot run longer than 20 s without a new stake (the 2-3 drop-off stretches of every audited video)

conflict_check.policy: KJV public domain; our narration and footage original or licensed; AI visuals disclosed
conflict_check.coherence: is the series of SERIES.md; the long video becomes one story, not only a compilation, if validated

funnel.reading: in this line the two formats win with different audiences: no long winner got there through Shorts, and no Short winner turned its Shorts audience into long views. A Short-to-long funnel is not shown by the market; it has to be proven on our own channel (YouTube Analytics: the long's views by traffic source SHORTS, and their watch time) before it is relied on.

script.note: beat map for our long (one arc = one complete story = its 4 Shorts), from the counted order of the 7 audited winners; every target is the best winner value (BEAT_THE_REFERENCE_RULE). The long earns its own traffic (browse, suggested, search); traffic from the arc's Shorts is a plus (owner, 2026-10-26), measured by goal_report's funnel
script.keeper: the Keeper appears in every long (owner, 2026-10-26), never in the cold open, <= 25 % of the runtime; no winner has a host (0/7), so his share is measured against our own retention

beats.rule: the arc's peak conflict acted (the Short's hook shot), a character speaks the conflict (KJV line where the text has one); ends on an open question (winners 7/7: conflict in the first 30 s)
the Keeper on screen, <= 20 s: what this story really is, the one thing most readers miss, and the payoff promised at the end

one chapter per Short of the arc, chapter titles = the Short titles; each chapter ends on a re-hook line (a question or a cliffhanger) and one more mid-chapter in chapters over 4 min: >= 6 re-hooks (winners 4-9)
the opposition rises chapter by chapter (winners 4-6 steps), acted in dialogue by the character bible's cast
the hero (or God, as voice-over) speaks the key KJV line at the turn (4/7 winners)
the outcome shown in one sequence; no administrative aftermath (the 42-44 min drop of the furnace winner)
the Keeper: one original insight from the KJV text and its link to the next story; no sermon (winners 0-125 s; the weak Sodom spent 6 min)
a comment question and the next story by name (the next arc's first Short)

retention: no landscape, montage, process or repeated shot run longer than 20 s without a new stake (10/10 audited videos lose viewers there)
one complete story, never 'Part N' (winners 7/7, weak 1/3)
no burned captions on the long (anti: winners 1/7, weak 2/3; re-check with more weak contrasts)
script.open: no structure attribute separates winners from weak yet: the next mining is the package (thumbnail, title) with more weak contrasts, and our own longs' retention curves

gate.note: the machine-readable targets of this beat map: production/script_check.py structure_problems refuses a Bible-story long script that misses one, and ops/runway.py counts a long slot as filled only by a script that passes them (owner, 2026-10-26: the long stands on its own and follows this structure; prayer longs stopped)

segment_fields.conflict: true on the cold-open line that names the conflict; it starts inside cold_open_s and is spoken by a character (speaker), never the Keeper
segment_fields.speaker: who speaks a line on screen (a character of production/characters, or god for God's voice)
segment_fields.keeper: true on every segment the Keeper speaks on screen
segment_fields.climax: true on the one climax segment

script_fields.burned_captions: false: the long carries YouTube captions (our SRT), no captions burned into the picture
